wishes.title: 🎉 FINALLY HAPPIEST BIRTHDAY My Love 🎉
wishes.text: Happy Birthday meri jaan ❤️ Aaj ka din mere liye sirf aapki birthday nahi, balkay us din ka shukrana hai jab Allah ne aapko meri zindagi mein bheja. Aap mere har dukh ka sukoon aur har khushi ki wajah hain. Jab se aap aaye hain, har lamha khoobsurat ho gaya hai. Meri bas yahi dua hai ke aap hamesha muskurate rahein, har kamyabi aapke kadam choome, aur hamara yeh saath hamesha aise hi qayam rahe. I love you so much, Hamid! ✨🎂
